items.title: French politician Mélenchon warns against strikes on Moscow
items.summary: French politician Jean-Luc Mélenchon warned that attacks on Moscow could provoke a severe Russian response, arguing that France would be particularly vulnerable to retaliation against its nuclear facilities. His remarks were a warning about escalation, not an announcement of any planned attack.

items.title: Reports describe large Ukrainian drone attack on Russia and attempted strike on Crimean Bridge
items.summary: Reports say Ukrainian drones launched a large attack against Russia and made another unsuccessful attempt to strike the Crimean Bridge. The account did not specify the number of drones involved or the locations and extent of any damage.

items.title: Zelensky reportedly threatens reciprocal strikes on Russian energy infrastructure
items.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky reportedly pledged strikes against Russian energy infrastructure in response to blackouts in Ukraine. He also said Russian attacks increasingly target transmission lines and power grids to disconnect entire regions from electricity supplies.

items.title: Ukraine reportedly confirms Saab 340 airborne early-warning aircraft in service
items.summary: The Ukrainian Air Force has reportedly confirmed the presence of a Saab 340 airborne early-warning and control aircraft in its fleet for the first time. A photograph reportedly shows the aircraft over Ukraine, where it supports coordination of aviation operations during large-scale attacks.
